Kotlin Multiplatform native D-Bus: `src/commonMain/kotlin` shared API/serialization; `src/nativeMain/kotlin` + `src/nativeInterop/cinterop` Linux native/C interop; `src/nativeTest/kotlin/{unit,integration,mocks}` tests/fixtures; `codegen/` JVM XML-to-Kotlin CLI/library; `plugin/` `com.monkopedia.sdbus.plugin` Gradle plugin over `:codegen`; `compile_test/` compile-time dependency wiring; `samples/bluez-scan/` example consumer.

Use repo-root wrapper: `./gradlew build` full build; `./gradlew test` JVM/native tests; `./gradlew ktlintCheck` style; `./gradlew licenseCheck` license/required checks; `./gradlew dokkaHtml` docs in `build/dokka`; `./gradlew codegen:fatJar` release JAR. CI runs `gradle publish codegen:fatJar` and `gradle dokkaHtml` on Ubuntu.

Follow `.editorconfig`: 4 spaces, LF, max 100 chars. `ktlint` (`android_studio`); `UpperCamelCase` classes, `lowerCamelCase` functions/properties; clear packages under `com.monkopedia.sdbus`. Intentional public API changes; binary compatibility validation (`apiValidation`). Tests: `src/nativeTest`, `codegen/src/test/kotlin`, `plugin` tests.
